view3d.selectHint: Select a part to import a model for its footprint.

view3d.footprintNote: A model applies to every part with this footprint.

ai.note: Answers from a model can be wrong. Please verify pin assignments, ratings and part recommendations against the datasheet.

provider.title: AI provider
provider.rulesHint: The rule analysis works without a model and without a network. Nothing leaves this computer.
provider.localHint: Uses a server you run yourself, such as Ollama, llama.cpp or LM Studio. TronicCAD includes no model. Model size and GPU use are set in that server.

locality.local: Local: data stays on this computer.
locality.external: External: data leaves this computer, only with your consent.

key.title: API key
key.unavailable: The key store of the operating system is not available. Keys cannot be saved, and TronicCAD will not store them anywhere else.
key.stored: A key is in the key store of the operating system.
key.label: New key

status.loaded: {{name}}: {{size}} GB loaded, {{gpu}} GB of it on the GPU.
status.notReported: This server does not report memory or GPU use.

checks.title: Checked by TronicCAD
checks.hint: Computed by the checks themselves. A model cannot change these numbers.

rules.title: Rule analysis
rules.hint: Fixed rules, no model involved. These are hints, not check results.
rules.none: The rules found nothing to point out.

findings.led_without_resistor: {{led}} has no series resistor. Without one, the current is not limited.
findings.led_current: {{led}} with {{resistor}}: about {{milliamps}} mA at {{volts}} V, assuming {{forward}} V forward voltage.
findings.led_current_high: {{led}} with {{resistor}}: about {{milliamps}} mA at {{volts}} V, assuming {{forward}} V forward voltage. That is high for a standard LED.
findings.led_current_low: {{led}} with {{resistor}}: about {{milliamps}} mA at {{volts}} V, assuming {{forward}} V forward voltage. It may hardly light up.
findings.no_decoupling: {{part}} has no decoupling capacitor from {{net}} to ground.
findings.base_without_resistor: The base of {{part}} has no resistor on its net. The base current may not be limited.
findings.opamp_no_feedback: {{part}} has no feedback from its output to the inverting input.
findings.divider: {{upper}} and {{lower}} divide the voltage: {{net}} is at about {{volts}} V without load.
findings.fab_thin_tracks: Minimum track width {{value}} mm is below {{limit}} mm. Many low-cost manufacturers charge extra or refuse.
findings.fab_small_vias: Via drill {{value}} mm is below {{limit}} mm. Many low-cost manufacturers charge extra or refuse.
findings.board_no_mounting_holes: The board has no mounting holes.

chat.title: Assistant
chat.noProvider: To ask a model, please set a provider. The rule analysis above works without one.
chat.truncated: The answer hit the length limit and is incomplete.
chat.refused: The model or its provider declined to answer.
chat.question: Your request
chat.cutKnown: The server may have cut this request: the model then saw only part of the data, and the answer can be wrong. Context of the model: {{limit}} tokens. With Ollama, raise OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH, or send less.
chat.cut: The server may have cut this request: the model then saw only part of the data, and the answer can be wrong. Please send less, or raise the context in the server.

consent.body: This request goes to {{origin}}, model {{model}}. Nothing has been sent yet.

proposal.title: Proposed changes
proposal.empty: When a model proposes changes, they appear here. Nothing changes without your approval.
proposal.hint: Nothing has changed yet. Choose what to apply. It becomes one undo step.

proposal.applied: The changes were applied. Undo in the schematic takes them back.

reason.unreadable: The block of changes cannot be read: {{detail}}
reason.unknown_symbol: This symbol is not in the library: {{detail}}

proposal.skipped: Left out, because a change it needs was not chosen: {{reason}}

cloud.noTargets: Local work needs none of this. Add a folder, a server or the cloud to synchronize or back up.
cloud.savedOnly: Only the saved file travels. Unsaved changes stay here.
cloud.noLinks: This project is not connected to any storage.
cloud.unlinkNote: Disconnecting and removing delete nothing at the storage. Stored versions cannot be deleted from TronicCAD.
cloud.restored: The version was restored. The state before it is kept as .bak, and the next sync stores this as the newest version.

add.title: Add storage
add.name: Name

conflict.title: Two versions exist
conflict.body: The project was changed here and at {{name}}, or by two devices at once. Nothing was overwritten. Which state should continue?

cloud.merged: brought together: {{here}} from here, {{there}} from there

team.title: Team
team.noCloud: Teams need a TronicCAD cloud or team server. Please add one under Cloud.
team.codeHint: There is no e-mail service. Please pass on this code yourself. It is shown once and only works for this address.
team.attach: Put this project in the team
team.attachNote: Saved states of this project then go to this server, and the team can read them.
team.attached: The project now belongs to the team. Sync it under Cloud.
team.areasHint: People can work in different areas at the same time. A lock keeps others out of an area until it is released or expires after 4 hours. The server checks what each version really changes.
team.chainIntact: Checked: the log chain is intact.
team.chainDamaged: The log was changed outside the application, first at entry {{seq}}.
team.assignHint: Contributors can only change what is assigned to them.
